Petitioners herein seek quashing of FIR No. 0762/2022 dated 19.12.2022, registered at Police Station Uttam Nagar, for commission of offences under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC, along with all consequential proceedings arising therefrom, on the basis of compromise arrived at between the parties.
2. When the charge-sheet was filed, offence under Section 354-C IPC was also added as there was allegation of voyeurism, attributable to dewar i.e. petitioner No.4 herein.

3. Respondent No.2 has joined the proceedings through video-conferencing and though she submits that the matter has been amicably settled and would have no objection if the present FIR is quashed,
however, in view of the allegations appearing in the charge-sheet, it will be appropriate, if she appears in person before this Court so that the Court is in position to record its due satisfaction about the Memorandum of Understanding in This is a digitally signed order.
